outlook.statement: Looking forward, India's economic prospects are projected to be steady. Headwinds to growth include elevated geopolitical and trade uncertainties and possible energy & commodity price shocks. However, position of Indian Economy is better than the other developing economies which provide stable environment and a hope for near-term growth.

West Asia crisis due to ongoing war between Iran-USA-Israel threatens India with major supply-side shock, elevating risks of stagflation and higher trade deficits. Middle East region is a major destination for Indian Paper Exports which are also impacted. Domestic demand expected to grow in step with country's economy but global factors will impinge on Paper Industry's performance.
